review_comment_lines_check.name: review_comment_lines_check
review_comment_lines_check.value: ("review_comment"."side" is null) = ("review_comment"."line" is null) and ("review_comment"."line" is not null or "review_comment"."start_line" is null)

workspace_invite_accepted_by.name: workspace_invite_accepted_by
workspace_invite_accepted_by.value: "workspace_invite"."accepted_by_id" is null or "workspace_invite"."accepted_at" is not null

workspace_invite_ended_once.name: workspace_invite_ended_once
workspace_invite_ended_once.value: not ("workspace_invite"."accepted_at" is not null and "workspace_invite"."revoked_at" is not null)

workspace_token_issued_expiry_idx.name: workspace_token_issued_expiry_idx
workspace_token_issued_expiry_idx.where: "workspace_token"."issued_by_trust_id" is not null or "workspace_token"."run_id" is not null

memory_proposal_decided_matches_state.name: memory_proposal_decided_matches_state
memory_proposal_decided_matches_state.value: ("memory_proposal"."state" = 'proposed') = ("memory_proposal"."decided_at" is null) and ("memory_proposal"."decided_by_id" is null) = ("memory_proposal"."decided_at" is null)

runner_pool_one_mode.name: runner_pool_one_mode
runner_pool_one_mode.value: ("runner_pool"."token_hash" is null) <> ("runner_pool"."provision_url" is null) and ("runner_pool"."provision_url" is null) = ("runner_pool"."provision_secret" is null)

runner_pool_egress_pushes.name: runner_pool_egress_pushes
runner_pool_egress_pushes.value: "runner_pool"."provision_egress" is null or "runner_pool"."provision_url" is not null

sandbox_host_has_one_credential_source.name: sandbox_host_has_one_credential_source
sandbox_host_has_one_credential_source.value: ("sandbox"."host_id" is null) = ("sandbox"."pool_id" is null and "sandbox"."trust_id" is null) and ("sandbox"."pool_id" is null or "sandbox"."trust_id" is null)

run_turn_check.name: run_turn_check
run_turn_check.value: ("run"."state" = 'suspended') = ("run"."turn" is not null) and ("run"."turn" is null) = ("run"."turn_report" is null) and ("run"."turn" is null) = ("run"."suspended_at" is null)

run_working_copy_check.name: run_working_copy_check
run_working_copy_check.value: ("run"."working_copy_key" is null) = ("run"."working_copy_rejoinable" is null) and ("run"."working_copy_key" is null) = ("run"."working_copy_restores" is null)

dispatch_subject_check.name: dispatch_subject_check
dispatch_subject_check.value:
case "dispatch"."kind"
        when 'task' then "dispatch"."task_id" is not null and "dispatch"."task_revision" is not null and "dispatch"."station_id" is not null and "dispatch"."chat_id" is null and "dispatch"."based_on_run_id" is null
        when 'chat' then "dispatch"."chat_id" is not null and "dispatch"."task_id" is null and "dispatch"."station_id" is null and "dispatch"."based_on_run_id" is null
        else "dispatch"."based_on_run_id" is not null and "dispatch"."task_id" is not null and "dispatch"."station_id" is not null and "dispatch"."chat_id" is null
      end
